tools.name: data-quality_csv-schema-detect
tools.description: Infer a column type from the supplied CSV or JSON values before you load or rely on a dataset. A column with more than one non-numeric type stays mixed. No value is rewritten. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDiscarded, dataModified, outliersConfirme

tools.name: data-quality_csv-profile
tools.description: Count present, missing, and distinct values for each column and report the minimum and maximum of the supplied values before you load or rely on a dataset. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDiscarded, dataModified, outliersConfirmed, format, recordsRe

tools.name: data-quality_csv-column-type-detect
tools.description: List the observed types in each column before you load or rely on a dataset. A value that differs from the most common type is referenced by row and column and is not changed. A tie is not blamed on a row. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDiscarded,

tools.name: data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit
tools.description: Find empty or whitespace-only cells and give each one a row and column reference before you load or rely on a dataset. The row stays in the table. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDiscarded, dataModified, outliersConfirmed, format, recordsRead, recor

tools.name: data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect
tools.description: Group records that match after trimming each compared cell before you load or rely on a dataset. When key columns are supplied, only those columns are compared. No record is removed. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDiscarded, dataModified, outliersC

tools.name: data-quality_csv-outlier-detect
tools.description: Flag numeric values outside a Tukey fence of 1.5 times the interquartile range when a column has at least eight numbers before you load or rely on a dataset. Each flag is a possible outlier, not a confirmed error. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recordsDis

tools.name: data-quality_csv-normalize
tools.description: Propose trim, email lowercase, boolean tokens, and unambiguous thousands separators before you load or rely on a dataset. Each change names its rule and keeps the original cell. Dates that are not already YYYY-MM-DD are not rewritten. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. HTTP 200

tools.name: data-quality_csv-report
tools.description: Combine the schema, profile, missing cells, duplicate groups, possible outliers, and proposed normalization for one supplied table before you load or rely on a dataset. No record is removed and no outlier is confirmed. Call with optional records, csv, json, file, keyColumns. Returns checkedAt, recor

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "data-quality" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: data-quality_csv-normalize · Private data: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report · Public sink: data-quality_csv-normalize · Destructive: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: data-quality_csv-normalize · Private data: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report · Public sink: data-quality_csv-normalize · Destructive: data-quality_csv-schema-detect, data-quality_csv-profile, data-quality_csv-column-type-detect, data-quality_csv-missing-value-audit, data-quality_csv-duplicate-row-detect, data-quality_csv-outlier-detect, data-quality_csv-normalize, data-quality_csv-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
